research_question: After adding the sealed exact transposition-orbit/count carrier to the already-sealed exact portfolio, which source-authorized connected-mixed raw fixtures survive exact normalization and all applicable sealed admissions and therefore remain real residual obstructions?
epistemic_rule: THIS_GATE_INVENTS_NO_NEW_SOLVER_OR_CARRIER. IT ONLY RECOVERS FROZEN SOURCE FIXTURES, NORMALIZES THEIR BOOLEAN SEMANTICS EXACTLY, DEDUPLICATES BY CANONICAL RAW SEMANTIC SHA256, AND REPLAYS ALREADY-SEALED ADMISSION/CARRIER MECHANISMS INCLUDING THE V1 ORBIT_COUNT_MECHANISM.

frozen_source_entries.semantic_raw_projection: raw_table obligations preserved; affine_eq obligations expanded exactly to their complete Boolean allowed-tuple relation before canonicalization
same underlying constraints as connected_or2_xor_sat with source L changed; include provenance but SHA-dedup on raw semantics

canonical_raw_schema.variables: sorted integer identifiers appearing in constraints
canonical_raw_schema.constraints: multiset of exact explicit Boolean relations represented by scope plus complete allowed tuple table

exact_normalization_contract.raw_table: preserve exact scope and all allowed tuples; canonicalize tuple order and constraint order only
exact_normalization_contract.affine_eq: enumerate the finite Boolean scope exactly and retain precisely assignments satisfying the frozen GF(2) equation; this is representation conversion only, not solving
exact_normalization_contract.universal_relation_rule: an explicit relation equal to the full Boolean cube on its scope may be deleted as an exact tautology before admission replay
forbidden_normalization: trusted carrier/family labels used as semantic authority
exact_normalization_contract.semantic_sha256: SHA256 of canonical variables plus canonical exact relation scopes/allowed-tuples after exact universal-relation deletion; source IDs, source L and carrier labels are excluded from the semantic hash
exact_normalization_contract.dedup_rule: all source entries remain in provenance ledger, but scientific obstruction counts are by unique canonical raw semantic SHA256

connected_mixed_eligibility.connected: the variable-constraint incidence graph of the normalized non-universal raw object has exactly one nonempty connected component
connected_mixed_eligibility.mixed: the complete normalized raw relation surface is not admitted by one common sealed raw Schaefer basis; historical source authority alone is insufficient if exact normalization proves the object no longer mixed
connected_mixed_eligibility.source_authorized: the constructor/control appears in the frozen pre-orbit source bindings above; no new result-dependent fixtures may be added after implementation begins
connected_mixed_eligibility.ineligible_after_normalization: record classification EXCLUDED_AFTER_EXACT_NORMALIZATION_NOT_CONNECTED_MIXED rather than silently dropping the source entry

sealed_portfolio_replay_contract.rule: Replay only already-sealed exact admissions/certificates. No new mechanism or fallback solver may be written inside the census.
sealed_portfolio_replay_contract.orbit_count_rule: invoke the frozen V1 candidate on the normalized raw variables+constraints object only; no family/carrier labels may be supplied; any SAT certificate must be independently replayed by the frozen V1 checker
sealed_portfolio_replay_contract.open_rule: if no listed sealed mechanism admits/solves the exact normalized object, classify it as a real post-orbit open obstruction; do not solve it by brute force or by a newly invented carrier
sealed_portfolio_replay_contract.first_open_rule: the lexicographically first unique raw semantic SHA256 that remains open must have its exact normalized object, source aliases, fingerprints, failed admission reasons and resource receipt frozen before any mechanism design

promotion_rule: This diagnostic may only say whether the frozen source-authorized corpus contains a surviving post-orbit obstruction. A no-obstruction result is finite-corpus evidence only and does not prove general connected-mixed tractability. A found obstruction authorizes freezing its exact profile before mechanism design; it does not authorize an ad hoc solver.
